title: Altcoins rally across the board as bitcoin consolidates near $84,000
summary: Quant jumped 39% over 24 hours and 93 of 100 CoinDesk 100 constituents rose, with the altcoin season index at its highest in more than three months.

title: Bitcoin ETFs have erased a $5.8 billion hole
summary: At one point in July, ETFs were down $5.8 billion in net outflows for the year. Now, that’s turned into $800 million in net inflows.

title: KelpDAO sues LayerZero for the largest exploit 2026 has seen so far
summary: The cross-chain lending protocol accused LayerZero and its co-founder Brian Pellegrino of failing to disclose weaknesses in their protocol, which led to the $292 million hack.

title: Live updates: Bitcoin steadies near $84,000 as the bond selloff pauses
summary: Treasury yields eased from multi-decade highs and oil slipped on reports of a phased U.S.-Iran deal, with roughly $14 billion in bitcoin options set to expire on Deribit on Friday.

title: Bitget's $352 million hack happened via spoofed transfers, not private keys, CEO Gracy Chen says
summary: Bitget lost $351.6 million after attackers compromised a wallet backend, spoofed transaction data, Chen said on X.
